title: His father the piccolo player and Punch Miller
summary: His father Mon-Gee played piccolo in parades with Eddie Johnson, his uncle; Punch Miller was his aunt's first boyfriend.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

My daddy played music. My daddy was a piccolo player. My daddy was the only piccolo player in the city. They called my daddy Mon-Gee.
Mon-Gee was my daddy. My daddy played with Eddie Johnson. Eddie Johnson was my uncle. Played the bass.

He played all the funnels in the parade.
Oh, really? I never heard of a piccolo player.
What bands did he play with?
Oh, Punch Miller. See Punch? Punch Miller was my auntie's first boyfriend.
I used to go get a beer for Punch. and put drink some of the beer and put water in the bucket and bring it back in.
